profile.name: Ethan Xie
summary: Computer Sceice and Economics student at Yale University. I enjoy developing cool things and learning new ideas. I am also really excited and interested in all things AI from interpretability to performance. My hobbies include guitar, reading, pool, Counter Strike, and golf.
This site is a putting course. Each hole is a section: sink the putt to open it, or skip the game and read the sections directly.

game.intro: Pull back from the ball and release to putt. Sink it to open the section.

modal.title: About me
modal.subtitle: Based in New Haven, Connecticut, Orginally from Irvine, California
paragraphs: I'm a student at Yale working toward a B.S. in Computer Science and Economics. I like building things end to end, from client websites to machine learning models written from first principles.
I co-founded a web studio that builds AI-enabled websites for small businesses, helped run hackathons with 250+ participants, and implemented a transformer and an autograd engine from scratch.
Skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Next.js, Git, Chinese.

modal.title: Projects
modal.subtitle: Built from scratch to understand how things work

items.title: Transformers
items.description: A decoder-only transformer implemented from scratch in PyTorch, with multi-head self-attention, layer normalization and residual connections. Trained on character-level and text datasets to study how model size and hyperparameters affect results.

items.title: Autograd Engine
items.description: A reverse-mode automatic differentiation engine in Python based on Karpathy's micrograd, with computational graphs, gradient propagation and backpropagation. Used it to train a convolutional neural network on MNIST.

items.title: Genetic Flappy Bird
items.description: A Flappy Bird simulator with an integrated neural network that learns how to play it.
